name: Felt Puppet Show
summary: A felt hand-puppet Pulse pops up on a tabletop stage to point at the anomaly — only a real human hand can press Roll back.
look: Fuzzy felt puppets with ping-pong eyes on a teal velvet stage with a wooden board and amber bulbs. Data lives on cream placards and a hand-drawn easel.

components.name: Felt hand puppet
components.role: Pulse: teal felt, ping-pong eyes, coral nose (the mark’s dot)

components.name: Grumpy co-star
components.role: grey-lilac puppet with heavy lids = the overwhelmed team

components.name: Stage booth
components.role: velvet curtain, fringed valance, wooden board that hides the hands

components.name: Placard on a stick
components.role: cream card for hook lines and the tagline

components.name: Marker easel
components.role: hand-drawn chart with −18% and the deploy line

components.name: Real hand + felt button
components.role: the human decision, deliberately not a puppet

motion.name: Pop-up
motion.how: puppets rise from behind the board, 0.25 s back.out(1.8) with a 2-frame overshoot hold; always entering on a downbeat

motion.name: Mouth flap
motion.how: jaw opens on each spoken syllable, locked to 8th notes (0.25 s at 120 BPM); stepped at 12 fps for a hand-performed feel

motion.name: Rod swing
motion.how: arm rods swing with sine.inOut 0.5 s pendulum overshoot; the button squash is 0.1 s scaleY 1→0.8→1 on the bar downbeat

story: Hook: a grumpy puppet buried in paper dashboards holds up 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: curtains part, Pulse pops up under an 'Acme Pulse' marquee. Proof: Pulse flaps its mouth at an easel showing checkout −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231 while a real hand presses the felt Roll back button. CTA: both puppets bow under 'Caught before customers noticed.' and a Start free ticket.
adapt: Swap the easel for your own screen or chart printed on a card, give your puppet your brand’s accent colour as its nose or tuft, and let a real hand perform your product’s main action.

references.note: felt-over-foam construction, wide mouths, protruding eyes

fit.risk: High production cost if shot practically, and silliness can undercut a serious incident story — keep the easel data crisp and the puppet’s gag to one beat.
